name: h
description: GitHub-installed FastMoss PID, Kie generation, and AdsPower TikTok publishing workflow with automatic runtime setup.

interface.displayName: H · PID / 生成 / 发布
interface.shortDescription: FastMoss PID → Kie 生成 → AdsPower 发布。
interface.longDescription: H installs from GitHub and exposes exactly three Chinese entry points: PID, generation, and publishing. Numeric product PIDs retrieve the original cover and title from FastMoss; uploaded images remain the visual source while PID data supplies title context and the exact later product attachment. Kie analyzes image and title together, processes a whole folder in one concurrent pool, and preserves resumable task records. Generated videos flow directly into AdsPower TikTok scheduling, where each video must retain its exact numeric PID and scheduled intervals use positive 30-minute multiples. First use prepares only the selected capability and supports Windows x64, Intel Mac, and Apple Silicon Mac without requiring a preinstalled Python or Node runtime.
defaultPrompt: 使用 H 根据商品 PID 从 FastMoss 拉取主图和标题，分析后生成视频。
使用 H 对图片或整个文件夹进行批处理或单处理生成。
使用 H 把视频按原 PID 精确挂商品，以 30 分钟倍数预约并发布到 TikTok。
